title: 鹈鹕骑单车 · Pelican on a Bike

source_analysis.finding: Page title is 鹈鹕骑单车 · Pelican on a Bike and describes a helmeted white pelican with red scarf riding a vintage bicycle along a coastline chasing fish, all realtime generated with no external textures.
Intro lists procedural modeling, two-bone IK pedaling, Verlet cloth scarf, Gerstner waves, day-night cycle, synthesized SFX plus generative music, and a fish-catching mini-game.

Repository confirms this deployment is pelican-bike: 11 JS modules (~800 KB single-file HTML build), with src modules pelican/bicycle/ocean/fish/sky/effects/audio and links the live URL claude-opus-5-5.riba2534.cn.

Repo README documents Three.js r186, esbuild inlined single HTML with no runtime external assets, Cloudflare Pages deployment, one-shot single-prompt generation with zero manual edits, and 964 stars / 135 forks.

Game page documents keyboard controls: W/S accelerate/brake, A/D lane change, Space jump, T hands-free trick + wheelie, B bell, H squawk, C camera, Q/E gears, N fast-forward 3h, M music, K screenshot, F fullscreen, U hide UI, P pause; plus drag-rotate, wheel-zoom, and click pelican/bell/sea surprises. Establishes keyboard_mouse supported.

Page contains coarse-pointer touch controls with on-screen buttons for left/right/up/down plus bell/trick/jump actions, and repo describes touch buttons with framerate-adaptive quality. Establishes mobile_controls supported.
No accelerometer/gyroscope or physical gamepad bindings are documented in the help, HUD, or repo description; support is unestablished. Establishes motion_controls and gamepad as unknown.

Gameplay is a single rider catching fish with score, 14 achievements, 5 cameras (orbit/chase/side/cinematic/pelican POV), auto-drive fish chasing when idle and gold fish worth 5 points; no multiplayer documented. Establishes 1 human player single-player.

Play URL returns HTTP 200 HTML with #app canvas, start button, speed/cadence/gear/distance/fish/achievement/clock HUD, and og:image gameplay render; it opens the playable game, not just a repo or promo page.

screenshots.observation: Inspected downloaded 1200x630 og:image: white pelican with red helmet, sunglasses and flowing red scarf pedaling a teal vintage PELICANO bicycle with wicker basket holding a blue fish, on a coastal asphalt road with white railing, turquoise Gerstner-style waves, palm trees, sailboat, gulls and pink-orange sunset sky. Coherent stylized 3D, game's own runtime output.

screenshot_based_score.reason: Judged only from the inspected gameplay still without inferring motion. Coherent stylized 3D with detailed character/bike modeling, cloth scarf, textured road, animated-look water, palms and sunset lighting and good composition. Above Sakura Rally (68, no car/HUD), OSRS Tower Defense (65), HYPERBRICK (62) and Arkanoid Neon (55) on character detail and scene polish. Below moorestech (76, denser systems HUDs and open world) and Arkenfall (78, denser layered architecture/vegetation) on scope and detail density; on par with DERELICT (72) and DRIFTWING (72) polished 3D loops. Single curated og:image only, so capped; still proves nothing about motion or performance.

reconstructed_prompt: Create a realtime 3D browser game of a helmeted pelican with red scarf riding a vintage bicycle along a coastal highway chasing fish. Procedurally model everything with Three.js (no external textures): two-bone IK pedaling, Verlet cloth scarf, Gerstner ocean waves, day-night cycle to starry night, palms/streetlamps. Gameplay: W/S accelerate/brake, A/D lane-change to catch fish (gold = 5 pts), Space jump, T wheelie trick, gears, 14 achievements, 5 cameras including cinematic and pelican POV, auto-drive when idle, clickable pelican/bell/sea. HUD with speed/cadence/gear/distance/fish/clock, touch buttons, Web Audio synthesized SFX plus generative music tied to cadence, adaptive quality, screenshot/share/fullscreen. Single-file esbuild HTML deployed to Cloudflare.
how_to_play: Open the play URL in a modern Chrome/Edge/Safari with WebGL and click 开始骑行 (Start riding)
Accelerate with W/Up and brake with S/Down; change lanes with A/D to line up fish
Press Space to jump, T for hands-free wings + wheelie trick, Q/E to shift gears manually
Ring with B, squawk with H, switch camera with C, fast-forward 3 hours with N
Drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, click the pelican, bell, or distant sea for surprises; idle a few seconds to auto-drive after fish
Catch fish to raise the counter (gold fish = 5); track speed, cadence, gear, distance, achievements 0/14 and time-of-day; M music, K screenshot, F fullscreen, U hide UI, P pause
mechanics: Coastal road cycling with accelerate/brake, 5 gears, lane-changing and jumping
Fish-catching collection with normal and 5-point gold fish plus basket inventory
Hands-free wing-spread wheelie trick, bell, pelican squawk and clickable world surprises
14 achievements, distance/speed/cadence tracking and time-of-day slider with auto flow
Five cameras: free orbit, chase, side follow, cinematic bars, pelican POV
Full day-night cycle from dusk to starry night with Gerstner waves and shore foam
Procedural pelican/bicycle/ocean/sky with two-bone IK pedaling and Verlet scarf cloth
Realtime synthesized SFX plus generative music whose tempo follows pedaling cadence
Touch button cluster, auto-drive fish pursuit when idle, adaptive quality and photo/share tools

rating.reason: Far from AAA: narrow single-loop casual rider with no narrative, progression beyond 14 achievements, multiplayer or live-ops scale; judged from live page, repo docs and still without full playthrough proving performance/feel/balance. Compared with all 73 catalog games excluding itself. Closest comparators are DERELICT (57, complete 3D loop with similar scope), Sakura Rally (56, deeper rally campaign/garage/replays but no verified web play), Kart Royale (50, complete polished 3D loop but single-track) and Turbo Kart Rally (40, thin kart loop). Pelican outranks Kart Royale/Turbo Kart Rally on verified technical execution (11 modules, IK pedaling, cloth, Gerstner water, day-night, cadence-driven generative music, 5 cameras, touch + auto-drive) and polish, sits near DERELICT/Sakura Rally, but below Meridian Wake (60, larger documented systems scope), Long Wind (62) and moorestech (64, years-iterated factory systems/co-op/mods) on gameplay depth and scope.

fictional_reviews.text: A sunset ride I did not want to end — the scarf flutter, ringing bell and gold-fish chases are pure cozy joy.
Lovely tech demo with real game bones, but I finished seeing its tricks in one evening and wanted more roads.
The pelican looked at me, I rang the bell, the sea glittered — a perfect little perfect game.
